name: Civil Air Patrol cadets, Wisconsin Wing
what_you_do: Join a cadet squadron near you. The Wisconsin Wing site lists programs like summer encampment, a wing conference and Legislative Day. Activity details are not on the pages read.
who_can_apply: The Wisconsin Wing site labels the cadet program as ages 12 to 19. The national CAP cadet page says between 12 and 18. The interest form lists grades 6 through 12 and high school graduates.
pay_detail: Dues and fees are not stated on the pages read. Ask the squadron.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Cadet Interest Form on the Wisconsin Wing site. The wing aims to pass your info to a local unit within 48 hours, and the unit should contact you within 48 hours after that. If you hear nothing in four days, email Major Todd Mandel at todd.mandel@wicap.us.
notes: Volunteer youth program, not a job. Ages differ between the Wisconsin page (12 to 19) and the national page (12 to 18), so confirm with the squadron. Wing address: 2400 Wright Street, Madison, WI 53704.
